messages:
maya: Starting a quick refresh of the "Hello Quickstart" guide for SDK v9 and the new token auth. Goal: update env var names, Docker + Cloud Run deploy examples, and add a short migration note.

oliver: Happy to take the Cloud Run and Docker commands. Which runtimes are we publishing?

maya: Node 20 and Python 3.11 only. Keep examples minimal to pass doc tests. Also note: env var renamed from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. Need a tiny migration snippet.

sam: I'll update the code snippets. Can someone paste a minimal Dockerfile we should include so I can run the doc build locally?

oliver: Minimal Dockerfile for node quickstart:
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

maya: Add curl examples with the new header: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and a note showing export REDWOOD_TOKEN in bash.

lia: Can we include where to rotate old keys in the console and a CLI one-liner to create a token? One short paragraph should be enough to avoid support churn.

maya: Yep. Add a Migration -> Auth subsection: `redwoodctl tokens create --name "docs-migration"` and link to Settings -> API Tokens in the console. Keep wording non-actionable for prod (demo only).

sam: Opening PR with updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4138. I added Dockerfile, curl examples, Cloud Run env var sample, and a 2-sentence migration note. CI lint flagged a long line which I corrected.

deploy-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-4138--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 15m)

oliver: I'll smoke-test the Cloud Run flow tomorrow morning and verify env var names align with examples.

lia: Suggestion: add a one-line troubleshooting item under Deploy -> Troubleshooting about CORS when testing from local pages: "For local demos add Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (demo only); follow production CORS guide for apps."

maya: Good call. Also add a note about local env override precedence so users know how to run with different tokens during testing.

sam: Updated PR with the CORS note and local override sentence. Assigning reviewers @maya @oliver @lia. All doc tests pass locally for both node and py snippets.

maya: Thanks — I'll review tonight. If clean, let's merge before the docs sync and publish the preview in the meeting.

oliver: :thumbsup: Will report back after Cloud Run test.
